stop: transport failure, incomplete/capped output or named spill
missing/duplicate actual receipt, unexpected marker, read/close failure or nonempty final state
future_probe.pre_dispatch: Recheck pins, exact request, original target case leaf and Git path identity without changing them; fresh read-only inventory for the probe name; explicit synthetic route grant. No staging, alternate session, data scope or fallback route.
future_probe.interpretation: A target open failure is a useful observation when control succeeds, not a successful qualification or proof of ACL causation. Both markers must be observed for a both-readable verdict.
